framework_lessons: Seek cash-generating hedges and inspect each trust assumption.
assessment: Exxon performed well in the disclosed two-year sensitivity, and the explicit NVIDIA-versus-Exxon annual earnings crossover occurred within the stated window. The useful distinctions are between cash flow and valuation, and between reduced and eliminated custody risk. Some causal shortcuts remain: acquisition arbitrage contaminates short-interest sentiment, improving LEI momentum is not a rising LEI level, and annual deficits cannot mechanically offset concentrated property losses. The source includes an apparent Q4-2024/Q4-2023 correction, another reason not to assume the current text is an authenticated original vintage.
verification_limitations: Retrieved November 7, 2026; the current webpage is not authenticated as the original publication-date wording.
Chart labels were read but pixels and proprietary indicator vintages were not inspected.

Adjusted-close evidence is a vendor proxy for reinvested distributions and splits, in USD without fees or taxes. It does not reconstruct actual portfolio trades. Chosen sensitivity windows are not author deadlines. Macro series use latest vintages.
